devil_advocate.benign_hypothesis: Carry is a socially active Krasnovian-American who legitimately wanted to organize a flash mob at the National Gallery and used a newly purchased tablet for the event. The multiple email accounts may reflect personal privacy preferences rather than operational cover. Contact with @m57.biz addresses could be spam or mailing list traffic.

refutation.identity_construction: Three accounts created in 69 minutes on a brand-new device with zero personal use history. Privacy preferences do not require three compartmentalized communication channels activated simultaneously on a single-purpose device.
refutation.steganographic_delivery: The Dropbox 'funny video.mp4' attachment in a recruitment email from a known handler (Alex) is inconsistent with family communication. The body text explicitly references 'business in the states.'
refutation.coordinated_operatives: Seven @m57.biz addresses sending identical-subject emails in 10-20 minute intervals on the same day as handler contact. Spam does not produce uniform subjects from distinct senders in coordinated timing windows.
refutation.insider_recruitment: Carry exploited Tracy's documented financial distress, escalated from rapport to physical access to security intelligence purchase. The bribery offer is explicit in the email text. This is not flash mob coordination.
refutation.anti_forensics: 20+ email cache files deleted pre-seizure while metadata survived in EmailProvider.db. Routine cache management does not produce selective content-only deletion with metadata retention.
refutation.covert_storage: wpa_supplicant.conf at 7.66/8.0 entropy is physically inconsistent with its declared format (plain-text INI). This is either encrypted data or a compressed payload.

devil_advocate.gate_result: Benign hypothesis FAILS — cannot explain anti-forensic email deletion, covert storage entropy anomaly, explicit bribery text, or compartmentalized identity construction without internal contradiction. MALICE verdict SUSTAINED.
